publishers.identified_name: JP Zālo Publications / American Composers Alliance
publishers.identity_evidence: The current ACA collection identifies JP Zālo as the flute-music imprint founded by James J. Pellerite in 1974. Daniels also identifies ZALO/JP with Pellerite and Native American flute music.
publishers.score_or_recording: Printed and digital sheet music catalog. The four opened/filter-listed Snyder titles are flute repertoire.
publishers.verification: Current direct HTTP retrieved the collection description, exact composer filter and four product titles. Prism and Timescapes product pages also opened in web reader.
publishers.uncertainty: This establishes the current ACA JP Zalo collection, not every historical JP publication or successor holding. None of its four Snyder entries matches the ten requested saxophone titles. The old /composers/zalo-jp-publications URL returned 404.

publishers.identified_name: Brixton Publications, catalog now at Cimarron Music Press
publishers.identity_evidence: Brixton's official profile directs its graded score catalog to Cimarron. Current browser catalog has a Brixton menu and Randall Snyder score entries.
publishers.score_or_recording: Sheet music. Flute World separately offers Brixton's Iridescence as score and parts for flute, clarinet and piano. This unrelated work corroborates the score imprint; it is not a substitute for a requested saxophone title.
publishers.verification: Opened official profile in web reader, ordinary Cimarron search through browser and Iridescence retailer product through web reader.
publishers.uncertainty: Cimarron search tokenizes names broadly and also returns Randy Snyder and other composers. The exact Randall Snyder filter and second page were blocked by Cloudflare security checks. The attempted Chance Designs site search returned 100 broad token matches. Therefore this is an incomplete current catalog check. No requested exact score was verified; that does not prove absence from Brixton.

publishers.identified_name: Exact imprint identity unresolved. Distinguish Vienna Modern Masters label and Vienna Masterworks score imprint.
publishers.identity_evidence: UNL uses Vienna Modern Masterworks among Snyder's publishers. Mica identifies Vienna Modern Masters as a contemporary-music recording label founded by Nancy Van de Vate in 1990 and links its website via a web archive. A separate mica work record identifies Vienna Masterworks as the score publisher of Nancy Van de Vate's Contrasts and Vienna Modern Masters as the recording label.
publishers.score_or_recording: Vienna Modern Masters is a recording label. Vienna Masterworks is documented as a score imprint for other repertoire. Neither establishes a current sale of any of these ten Snyder scores.
publishers.verification: Current direct HTTP retrieved both mica records. The Contrasts record offers digital score ordering for that unrelated Nancy Van de Vate work.
publishers.uncertainty: No current official catalog or specific Snyder order instruction under the exact requested Vienna Modern Masterworks name was verified. Do not equate similarly named organizations without stronger evidence. Do not infer closure. Audio releases on Vienna Modern Masters are not score purchases.
